sentimento.text1: 📈 THE WINNER CONTRACT GAP WIDENED FROM 14.00pp TO 16.25pp, AND THIS TIME IT WIDENED BECAUSE LULA FELL, not because Flávio Bolsonaro rose: Flávio Bolsonaro went from 56.50% to 56.75% (vol USD 11.03M accumulated), a rise of 0.25pp, and Lula went from 42.50% to 40.50% (vol USD 11.41M accumulated), a fall of 2.00pp, reading confirmed on 19/Sep, 19:20 BRT, against the price confirmed on 18/Sep. ⭐ Those 16.25pp are Flávio Bolsonaro's largest lead over Lula since 14/Apr, the start of the series recorded in the database, which holds 633 readings across 156 days. The opposite extreme of that same series is 41.80pp in Lula's favour, on 01/Aug.
sentimento.text2: ⚖️ THE DAY'S MOVE IS NOT IN THE HEADLINE BOOK, IT IS IN THE SECONDARY ONES. In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second-place contract Flávio Bolsonaro rises 5.00pp, from 69.50% to 74.50%, and Lula falls 4.70pp, from 29.35% to 24.65%. That is twenty times what the same Flávio Bolsonaro moved in the winner contract, which was 0.25pp. The two books measure different things and do not contradict each other: one pays for winning the election, the other for finishing the first round in second place, and a candidate can become more likely on both readings at once. The panel records both prices and assigns no cause to either move.
sentimento.text3: 🔴 NO NATIONAL POLL WAS PUBLISHED ON 19/Sep, AND THE PANEL'S BENCHMARK IS STILL THE ONE FROM 17/Sep. Datafolha, face to face, fieldwork from 15 to 16/Sep, 2,002 interviews and a 2.0pp margin, gives Lula 46% to 44% in the [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno). Futura Inteligência commissioned by 100% Cidades, by telephone, fieldwork from 11 to 15/Sep, 2,000 interviews and a 2.2pp margin, gives Flávio Bolsonaro 48.1% to 43.7%. That is 6.4 points between the two firms on the same pair, with the sign reversed. 📅 The [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) registry marks twelve national polls for the coming days, six of them for 24/Sep, among them Datafolha, PoderData, AtlasIntel on 23/Sep, and two Palver waves on 20/Sep. First-round voting is on 04/Oct.
sentimento.direita: Flávio Bolsonaro at 56.75% in the winner contract, up 0.25pp against the price confirmed on 18/Sep. In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second-place contract he rises 5.00pp, to 74.50%, the largest move of the day in any book on the panel. In the two national polls of 17/Sep he has 44% in the runoff at Datafolha, behind Lula, and 48.1% at Futura, ahead. On 19/Sep he held a rally in Santa Catarina on the same day as Lula.
sentimento.esquerda: Lula at 40.50% in the winner contract, down 2.00pp against the price confirmed on 18/Sep, and 27.00pp below the top of his series, 67.50% on 16/Aug. In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second-place contract he falls 4.70pp, to 24.65%. In the first round he leads both national polls of 17/Sep, 39% to 36% at Datafolha and 38.3% to 37.7% at Futura, and in both the gap fits inside two margins. The accumulated volume of his contract, USD 11.41M, is larger than Flávio Bolsonaro's, USD 11.03M.
sentimento.terceiraVia: 🥉 IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) THIRD-PLACE CONTRACT RENAN SANTOS' LEAD OVER AUGUSTO CURY DOUBLED IN ONE DAY: Renan Santos rises 2.00pp, to 51.00%, Cury falls 4.65pp, to 36.35%, and Ronaldo Caiado rises 1.00pp, to 11.50%, against the values confirmed on 18/Sep. The gap between the top two went from 8.00pp to 14.65pp. ⚠️ In the WINNER contract the same Renan Santos falls 0.10pp, to 0.85%. The two prices do not contradict each other: one measures finishing third, the other measures winning. The polls of 17/Sep put Augusto Cury ahead in both, 6% to 3% at Datafolha and 6.5% to 3.4% at Futura, which is the reverse of the book's order.
sentimento.polymarket: Prices from the reading of 19/Sep, 19:20 BRT (22:20 UTC). AFOS only publishes a price that two independent readings, eight minutes apart, confirm within 0.20pp, and certification is per book: in this round four of the five watched contracts received a new price, winner, second and third place in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) and impeachment at the Supreme Court. The Senate majority contract did not, and this round publishes no new number for it. Presidential book at USD 151.75M accumulated. ⚠️ The largest accumulated volume in the presidential book does not belong to the leader: it belongs to the Tarcísio de Freitas contract, with USD 14.08M, which today trades at 0.05%.

inss.text1: 🔴 THERE IS NO NEW ACT IN THE [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) FRAUD INQUIRY ON 19/Sep. What stands is still the act of 12/Sep, in which Edson Fachin took over as rapporteur of the investigation into Alexandre de Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro, and the procedural suspension he ordered also reaches the INSS cases, without changing their rapporteur.
inss.text2: ⚠️ WHAT SITS OUTSIDE THE GOVERNMENT'S COUNT HAS A FIGURE, AND IT IS STILL THE ONE FROM 03/Sep. Requests delayed beyond 45 days totalled 261 thousand in August, against 1.88 million requests in the full queue. The page keeps the previous figure because there was no new measurement, and it does not estimate.
inss.text3: The definition the government uses, given by the Social Security minister and quoted by Metrópoles on 03/Sep, is that clearing the queue means analysing faster than the legal deadline of 45 days, not having no request under analysis. The two sentences describe different realities, and the distinction belongs to the vocabulary rather than to the measurement.
inss.text4: 📌 What links the [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) to the [Banco Master](/en/glossary#banco-master) case here is procedural, not factual: both sets are suspended by the same decision, and the ruling the full court opened on it on 15/Sep was suspended by a request to review from Flávio Dino, with no decision through 19/Sep.
inss.impactoLula: There are four recent structured readings of government approval, from different firms and methods, and they do not compare as a series. Datafolha of Sep 17 measures 48% approval against 50% disapproval. Futura/100% Cidades of the same day measures 44.1% against 53.1%. AtlasIntel of Sep 17, by online questionnaire, measures 45.4% against 53.6%. Genial/Quaest of Sep 14 measured 43% against 50%. The four fall between 43% and 48% approval and between 50% and 53.6% disapproval, and the most favourable and the least favourable to the government came out on the same day.
inss.impactoGestao: Within Quaest itself the approval and disapproval series is this: 48% against 47% on Aug 05, 46% against 48% on Aug 14, 45% against 48% on Sep 02, 43% against 50% on Sep 07 and 43% against 50% on Sep 14. The 5-point fall in approval over about a month stopped in the latest round. ⭐ On the management scale, the Sep 14 release brings 32% positive rating, 27% regular and 38% negative, with 3% not answering, and that is the breakdown the block now uses, with a single date.
inss.conclusao: What this round measures on the subject is calendar, not act: there is no new act in the [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) fraud inquiry on 19/Sep, the ruling on the suspension that reaches those cases is still stalled on the review request of 15/Sep, and no new national poll has measured government approval since 17/Sep.

bancoMaster.text1: 🔴 ON 19/Sep THERE WAS NO DECISION ON THE REQUEST TO REVOKE DANIEL VORCARO'S DETENTION, filed by his defence on 18/Sep. On that same 19/Sep his father asked the Supreme Court to review the house arrest he is under. The ruling on whether to investigate Alexandre de Moraes has been suspended since 15/Sep by Flávio Dino's request to review, and the ruling on André Mendonça's conduct has been off the docket since 17/Sep, with no new date.
bancoMaster.text2: 📅 THE CHRONOLOGY THE RECORD SUPPORTS: on Sep 12 Fachin took over as rapporteur and suspended the cases; on Sep 14 the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) delivered to the justices' offices the full data extracted from Vorcaro's phone, André Mendonça lifted the seal on the data about Banco Master's payment network and Moraes filed with Fachin a 121-point petition asking for the immediate termination of the investigation; on Sep 15 the full bench opened the ruling on Moraes and Dino requested a review; on Sep 17 Fachin, as president of the Supreme Court, pulled the ruling on Mendonça from the Sep 23 docket; on Sep 18 Vorcaro's defence asked for the detention to be revoked. ⚠️ Vorcaro's testimony to the Federal Police has been rescheduled to Sep 24, and the Federal Police summoned Daniel and Henrique Vorcaro to testify on Sep 30 in another inquiry. Vorcaro has been detained since November 17, 2025.
bancoMaster.text3: ⚠️ The price on this page is from the reading confirmed on 19/Sep, 19:20 BRT. In that reading the contract on a Supreme Court justice leaving by impeachment before 2027 stands at 4.55%, with USD 92 thousand accumulated, 0.05pp below the 4.60% confirmed on 18/Sep, which is the smallest move of any contract on the panel in this round. It is a thin book, and the panel assigns the move to none of the day's acts.
bancoMaster.conclusao: The case goes into the weekend with no decision: the request to revoke the detention has been with Fachin since 18/Sep, the two requests to investigate Supreme Court justices are still without a date, and what appeared on 19/Sep was background reporting on the relationship between the prosecutor general and Vorcaro, not a procedural act. The panel records the procedure and the price, without saying which of the two better describes the outcome.

stf.toffoli: No new individual act confirmed by two independent sources on Sep 18. He remains a target of the impeachment request filed by Renan Santos.
stf.moraes: On 15/Sep the full court discussed whether he should be investigated over his relationship with Daniel Vorcaro, and the analysis was suspended by a request to review from Flávio Dino, with no decision on opening the investigation. Still without a new date on 19/Sep.
stf.gilmar: On Sep 18 he publicly acknowledged having had a meeting with Daniel Vorcaro and said he voted against Banco Master in a case he described as worth up to R$ 145 billion, saying the vote went against the banker (CartaCapital, Valor Econômico and Gazeta do Povo). On Sep 14 his office had received from the Federal Police the full data extracted from Vorcaro's phone.
stf.dino: On 15/Sep he filed a request to review in the ruling on investigating Alexandre de Moraes, which suspends the analysis for up to 90 days, and he had not returned the case by 19/Sep. On 17/Sep he asked the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) and the securities regulator to look into links between [Banco Master](/en/glossary#banco-master) and a cemetery concession holder, in a case that names André Mendonça.
stf.mendonca: On Sep 17, at the Superior Electoral Court, he rejected a federal deputy's filing against the Bolsa Família increase for lack of standing, and wrote in the decision that this is no pronouncement on the legality or constitutionality of the measure. That same night he was drawn as rapporteur of a second filing, by Renan Santos, on the same increase. At the Supreme Court, the ruling on the request to investigate his conduct as rapporteur of the Banco Master case has been off the docket since Sep 17, with no date.
stf.nexo: The link to the election is one of calendar and institution, not of outcome. The two requests to investigate Supreme Court justices tied to the [Banco Master](/en/glossary#banco-master) case remain without a date, and the request to revoke Vorcaro's detention has been with Fachin since 18/Sep, undecided. On 18/Sep the First Panel rejected the public defender's appeal and upheld Eduardo Bolsonaro's sentence of 4 years and 2 months for coercion in the course of proceedings, a conviction handed down in June of this year. In the reading confirmed on 19/Sep, 19:20 BRT the contract that pays on a Supreme Court justice leaving by impeachment before 2027 stands at 4.55%, 0.05pp below the previous day. The panel does not claim the procedure moved the price.
stf.analise: 🏛️ THE CONTRACT ON A SUPREME COURT JUSTICE LEAVING BY IMPEACHMENT BEFORE 2027 STANDS AT 4.55% (vol USD 92 thousand accumulated), reading confirmed on 19/Sep, 19:20 BRT, 0.05pp below the 4.60% of the price confirmed on 18/Sep. ⚠️ It is a thin book, and across the readings recorded on 19/Sep it ranged from 4.60% to 4.60%, with USD 19 of new money. It remains 21.55pp below the top of the series, 26.10% on 11/Sep, and 2.45pp above the floor, 2.10% on 08/Jun.
stf.fachin: On 17/Sep, as president of the Supreme Court, he pulled from the 23/Sep docket the ruling on the request to investigate André Mendonça's conduct as rapporteur of the [Banco Master](/en/glossary#banco-master) case, setting no new date. Since 18/Sep he has had on his desk the request to revoke Daniel Vorcaro's detention, with no decision through 19/Sep, and the defence promises to appeal to the full court if it is denied.
